tuition.note: Annual tuition (incl. 10% VAT) for international students admitted from abroad in 2026, academic year 2026-27; page does not label it by study level

requirement.text: Apply directly to the Office of International Students with an international exam or diploma: SAT Reasoning 1000/1600 (Math + Critical Reading), or SAT Subject 500+ in two relevant sections, or three relevant A-Levels at C or higher, or IB Diploma 28/45 with a relevant Higher Level subject, or a TUBITAK-recognised olympiad medal. Proof of English is required; IELTS overall 6.5 with no part below 5.5 exempts from the English preparatory programme.
